raw_payload.title: BAIR at CoRL 2026
raw_payload.description:
The Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) takes place November 9–12, 2026, in Austin, Texas. BAIR faculty, postdocs and students will be presenting research at various sessions, including an Early Career Keynote from Professor Negar Mehr. See below for the full schedule of sessions with BAIR members, including papers co-authored with collaborators at other universities and companies.

November 9–12, 2026Austin, TexasAll times CST · UTC−6

33Main-conference papers
4Late-breaking results (LBR) posters
10Orals & spotlights3 orals · 7 spotlights
4Days of researchNovember 9–12
MonNov 9 TueNov 10 WedNov 11 ThuNov 12 Main conference Nov 9–11 · Workshops Nov 12

Times shown for oral and spotlight papers are session windows. Individual presentation order is not specified. Papers appear in both their talk and poster sessions.

Paper inclusion: At least one author is affiliated with UC Berkeley; joint affiliations qualify. Faculty talks, session-chair roles and workshop participation are also included.

Late-breaking results: Four late-breaking posters with Berkeley authors are listed so far. This list may grow as more late-breaking posters are confirmed.

About this schedule

Schedule compiled from the conference program, paper and project pages, and workshop programs. Workshop schedules may change; consult each linked program for updates.

Coverage includes 33 main-conference papers, 4 late-breaking results posters and the workshop contributions listed above. The main conference demo track is not covered. Main-conference poster numbers follow an unofficial paper index; check the official program on the day. Hilton stage content will also be streamed to viewing rooms at the Marriott.

Paper affiliations reviewed November 6, 2026; late-breaking results updated November 8, 2026.
